project.name: Cordit
project.tagline: Public stranger chat + voice with live observer mode, music sharing, and dynamic wallpaper glassmorphism
project.description: Cordit is a next-generation real-time social communication platform. It bridges the spontaneous discovery of Omegle/Chatroulette with the persistent community feeling of Discord, introducing a spectator arena model where stranger conversations are publicly viewable and interactable via spectator suggestions.

theatre_observer_model.name: The Public Conversation as an Arena
theatre_observer_model.summary: Stranger chat is transformed from a private silo into a shared social stage.
theatre_observer_model.description: Traditional stranger chat platforms (like Omegle) hide interactions in isolated 1-on-1 silos. Cordit turns conversations into an engaging live arena: strangers converse in the spotlight while third-party users can watch live as read-only observers. This eliminates isolation, discourages toxic behavior through visibility, and creates an entertainment format similar to live-streamed casual debates.

crowdsourced_icebreakers.name: Observer Suggestion Engine
crowdsourced_icebreakers.summary: Spectators can actively enrich conversations without hijacking them.
crowdsourced_icebreakers.description: When strangers run out of things to say, awkward silences usually kill the conversation. Cordit solves this by allowing observers to submit icebreakers, trivia, questions, and discussion prompts into a dedicated side widget. Participants can view, accept, or ignore suggestions at their discretion.

numeric_public_identities.name: Anonymous Yet Accountable Identity
numeric_public_identities.summary: Clean 4-6 digit numeric handles (#7368) instead of email addresses or expose-prone handles.
numeric_public_identities.description: To protect privacy and eliminate social friction, users receive a randomly generated numeric public ID (e.g. #7368). The numeric ID decouples the user from their database identity, prevents doxxing, and eliminates personal data exposure, while still allowing persistent blocklists, moderation tracking, and report logging.

living_canvas_design_system.name: Wallpaper-Driven Reactive UI
living_canvas_design_system.summary: The desktop artwork is not merely a background; it dynamically controls the UI theme.
living_canvas_design_system.description: Rather than a static dark/light toggle, Cordit's theme engine inspects the selected wallpaper (cherry blossom, cyberpunk samurai, snowy aurora, sumi-e sunset) and dynamically adjusts UI surfaces, transparency levels, message bubble accents, glowing borders, active tab highlights, and audio waveform hues to blend with the wallpaper.

ultra_clear_frosted_glassmorphism.name: Depth Through Translucency
ultra_clear_frosted_glassmorphism.summary: High-transparency acrylic glass layers (backdrop-blur-md/xl) that never obscure the art.
ultra_clear_frosted_glassmorphism.description: All panels, headers, message containers, and sidebars utilize ultra-clear frosted glass styling (12% to 35% opacity) with subtle reflective borders (border-white/15 or border-purple-500/30) and diffuse shadows, giving the impression of floating optical acrylic sheets over a luminous canvas.

top_header.description: Global navigation and system status header anchored to the top of the viewport.

elements.details: A crimson/accent rounded squircle with 'C' glyph and bold 'Cordit' typography, paired with a glowing green/red LIVE status beacon.
Translucent frosted pill with palette icon. Clicking opens the Wallpaper Selector Modal.
Displays real-time notifications with an unread badge indicator.
Displays user avatar icon, numeric Public ID badge (e.g. #7368), and role indicator (e.g. Admin/User) with a dropdown menu for profile and logout.

left_navigation_rail.description: Slim lateral navigation dock providing access to primary views.

elements.description: Global lobby and featured room overview
Direct entry to 1-on-1 stranger matchmaking with observer mode
Saved media, notes, and session archives

central_chat_stage.description: Central conversation stage where stranger dialogue and spectator interactions take place.

elements.details: Displays channel name (# Stranger Chat), connected user pair pills (#7368 & #6202), vibrant 'PUBLIC ROOM' pill, observer counter badge ('4 Observers'), 'Report' flag trigger, and 'Leave' CTA.
Subtle top banner informing participants that the conversation is broadcasted live to spectators to encourage polite conduct.
Virtual scrolling feed with 'Today' date divider, floating timestamps, and smooth auto-scroll to latest message.
Two distinct styles: left-aligned stranger messages (dark translucent card with sender avatar squircle and numeric ID) and right-aligned user messages (accent-colored rounded capsule with YOU badge).
Centered frosted capsules announcing events such as 'user3 joined the room as observer' or 'Stranger has disconnected'.
Frosted input container with paperclip attachment button, emoji picker trigger, auto-resizing text field, and vibrant send button with paper airplane icon.

right_sidebar_widgets.description: Right auxiliary dock containing interactive audio and community widgets.

elements.details: Dynamic multi-bar audio waveform visualizer that reacts to speaking activity, participant list, per-user volume sliders, mute/deafen buttons, and a radiant 'Join Voice' button.
Collapsible card listing topics and icebreakers submitted by observers, showing spectator IDs, timestamps, and dismiss/accept actions, plus a '+ Drop a Suggestion' action for spectators.
Radar search animation displaying queue status, mutual gender preference toggles (My Gender vs Looking For), and a cancel queue button.
Interactive grid displaying high-res thumbnails for all 8 curated wallpapers with instant live preview and theme switching.
Safety reporting window capturing category (harassment, spam, inappropriate conduct), custom notes, and a snapshot of recent messages.
Confirmation modal before abandoning an active stranger match to avoid accidental disconnects.

Violet moonlit mountain wallpaper background with a centered glowing glassmorphic card, aperture brand icon, username/publicId input, password input with eye visibility toggle, floating red error capsule, and violet gradient login button.
Matching violet glassmorphic card with gender dropdowns, password input with show/hide toggle, optional invite code input with live validation spinner, and account generation button.

communication_and_matching.name: Mutual-Preference Matching Algorithm
communication_and_matching.description: Matches users in real time where user A's gender satisfies user B's preference, and user B's gender satisfies user A's preference.

communication_and_matching.name: Direct Public ID Search & Match
communication_and_matching.description: Enables two users who already know each other's numeric Public IDs (#7368) to bypass random queue and initiate a direct match.

communication_and_matching.name: Real-time Queue Pooling
communication_and_matching.description: In-memory socket matching pool handling disconnects, cancellations, and stale connection recovery.

social_and_observer_features.name: Zero-Approval Live Spectating
social_and_observer_features.description: Users can browse public stranger rooms and join as read-only spectators without interrupting participants.

social_and_observer_features.name: Live Observer Count Broadcast
social_and_observer_features.description: WebSocket broadcasts update the participant UI in real-time as observers enter or exit the room.

social_and_observer_features.name: Crowdsourced Suggestions Feed
social_and_observer_features.description: Spectators can submit conversation topics; participants can review or dismiss them live.

social_and_observer_features.name: Server-side Spectator Permission Enforcement
social_and_observer_features.description: Backend Socket.io middleware validates that only active room participants can emit chat messages; observer attempts are rejected.

voice_and_media.name: LiveKit WebRTC Voice Mesh
voice_and_media.description: Ultra-low-latency voice transmission using LiveKit SFU server.

voice_and_media.name: Dynamic Audio Waveform Visualizer
voice_and_media.description: Animated visual spectrum meters synchronized to speaking loudness.

voice_and_media.name: Browser Tab Music Sharing
voice_and_media.description: Direct audio track capture from any open browser tab (YouTube/Spotify) streamed directly into the voice room.

voice_and_media.name: Local High-Performance Media Storage
voice_and_media.description: File upload pipeline storing images and media permanently on disk with HTTP caching headers.

theming_and_aesthetics.name: Wallpaper-Driven Dynamic Theming
theming_and_aesthetics.description: Contextual UI adaptation that reads wallpaper metadata and updates CSS tokens for primary, accent, surface, bubbles, and waveforms.

theming_and_aesthetics.name: Curated 8-Artwork Gallery
theming_and_aesthetics.description: High-definition desktop wallpapers (Cherry Blossom, Crimson Wanderer, Anime Sunset, Samurai Moon, Aurora Valley, Starlit Valley, Crimson Mist, Headphones Red Moon).

theming_and_aesthetics.name: Ultra-Clear Glassmorphism
theming_and_aesthetics.description: 12% to 35% translucent acrylic styling with backdrop-blur-md/xl ensures background art is never obscured.

security_moderation_admin.name: Numeric Anonymous Public IDs
security_moderation_admin.description: Eliminates personally identifiable usernames/emails while preserving individual accountability.

security_moderation_admin.name: One-Click Permanent User Blocking
security_moderation_admin.description: Blocks target user from ever appearing in matching pools or sending direct requests.

security_moderation_admin.name: Context Snapshot Incident Reporting
security_moderation_admin.description: Attaches the last N messages of the active room to the report for objective admin review.

security_moderation_admin.name: Comprehensive /admin Dashboard
security_moderation_admin.description: Role-guarded control center for reviewing reports, suspending abusive accounts, generating invite codes, and monitoring platform metrics.
